seq = ""

    for line in f:

N = len(seq)
rc = seq.translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))[::-1]

STOPS = {"TAA","TAG","TGA"}

# returns list of (start_genomic_1based, end_genomic_1basedinclusive, strand, frame, length_nt)
results = []

# FORWARD strand, frames +1,+2,+3
for fr in (0,1,2):
    s = seq[fr:]
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(0, n-2, 1):
        if s[i:i+3] != "ATG":
            continue
        g_start = fr + i + 1          # genomic 1-based coordinate of A of ATG
        j = i
        found_stop = False
        while j+3 <= n:
            j += 3
            if s[j-3:j] in STOPS:
                g_end = fr + j        # genomic 1-based of last base of stop codon
                results.append((g_start, g_end, "+", fr+1, 3*(j-i)//3))
                found_stop = True
                break
        if not found_stop:
            results.append((g_start, None, "+", fr+1, None))

# REVERSE strand: scan rc, frames -1,-2,-3
for fr in (0,1,2):
    s = rc[fr:]
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(0, n-2, 1):
        if s[i:i+3] != "ATG":
            continue
        # position in rc (1-based, within slice) maps to genomic coordinate:
        # rc[k] (0-based over full rc) corresponds to genomic position N-k
        rc_index_of_A = fr + i                     # 0-based in full rc
        g_start = N - rc_index_of_A                # genomic coord of A of ATG (lowest genomic coord for +, highest for -)
        j = i
        found_stop = False
        while j+3 <= n:
            j += 3
            if s[j-3:j] in STOPS:
                last_base_rc = fr + j - 1          # 0-based in full rc
                g_end = N - last_base_rc           # genomic coord of last base of stop codon (- strand: lower coord)
                results.append((g_end, g_start, "-", fr+1, 3*(j-i)//3))
                found_stop = True
                break
        if not found_stop:
            results.append((N - g_start + 1, g_start, "-", fr+1, None))

def validate(st,en,strand):
    if strand == "+":
        sub = seq[st-1:en]
    else:
        sub = rc = seq[st-1:en][::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA"))
    ok_start = sub[:3]=="ATG"
    ok_stop = sub[-3:] in STOPS
    internal = sum(sub[k:k+3] in STOPS for k in range(0,len(sub)-3,3))
    return ok_start, ok_stop, internal

good = [r for r in results if r[4] and r[4] >= 120]
good.sort(key=lambda x: -x[4])
print("top ORFs (start,end,strand,frame,len_nt):")
